reading.title: Climate Change and Ocean Acidification
reading.passage: Ocean acidification is a critical consequence of climate change that threatens marine ecosystems worldwide. When atmospheric carbon dioxide increases, more CO2 dissolves into seawater, forming carbonic acid and lowering the ocean's pH level. This process weakens the shells of mollusks and corals, making it difficult for these organisms to survive. Pteropods, small marine snails, are particularly vulnerable because their shells dissolve in acidic water. Scientists warn that if current emission rates continue, ocean acidification could devastate fisheries and food chains that millions of people depend on for survival.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is the primary cause of ocean acidification?
options: B) Atmospheric carbon dioxide dissolving in seawater
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'When atmospheric carbon dioxide increases, more CO2 dissolves into seawater'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 정답은 B입니다.

questions.q: Which organisms are mentioned as being particularly vulnerable to ocean acidification?
options: C) Mollusks and corals, especially pteropods
questions.explanation: 지문에서 'mollusks and corals'와 'Pteropods, small marine snails, are particularly vulnerable'라고 명시되어 있으므로 정답은 C입니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest could happen if emission rates continue at current levels?
options: B) Ocean acidification could devastate fisheries and food chains
C) Marine life will adapt quickly
D) Coral reefs will grow stronger
questions.explanation: 지문의 마지막 부분에서 'if current emission rates continue, ocean acidification could devastate fisheries and food chains'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the following statement? Technology has made our lives more convenient but has also increased stress and anxiety in society. Use specific reasons and examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 제시(agree 또는 disagree) + 주요 이유 2-3개 언급 (2-3문장)
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주요 이유 전개 + 구체적 예시 제시 (5-7문장)
structure.body2: 두 번째 주요 이유 전개 + 구체적 예시 제시 (5-7문장)
structure.conclusion: 입장 재확인 + 전체 논의의 요약 + 광범위한 함의 제시 (2-3문장)

useful_phrases: In my opinion, technology has both advantages and disadvantages.
Furthermore, constant connectivity creates pressure to respond immediately to messages.
For example, social media platforms can lead to feelings of inadequacy and comparison.
On the other hand, technology enables remote work and flexible schedules.
In conclusion, while technology offers convenience, we must address its negative psychological effects.
It is evident that managing technology use is essential for mental well-being.

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to work for a large corporation with job security and structured career paths. Others prefer to work for a startup where they can take risks and have more creative freedom. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer working for a startup because...
One reason is that startups offer more opportunities for innovation and personal growth.
Another advantage is that I would have more direct impact on the company's success.
Additionally, the dynamic environment keeps work interesting and challenging.
However, I understand that job security is important for people with families.
To sum up, the creative freedom and learning opportunities at startups appeal to me more.
sample_points: 스타트업의 창의적 자유도: 새로운 아이디어를 즉시 구현할 수 있고, 다양한 업무를 경험하며 빠르게 성장할 수 있다는 점
개인의 영향력: 작은 팀에서 개인의 기여가 회사 전체에 미치는 영향이 크기 때문에 성취감과 동기부여가 높다는 점

listening.title: University Library Study Room Registration
listening.script: Student: Hi, I'd like to reserve a study room for tomorrow afternoon. Librarian: Sure! We have several options available. How many people will be using the room? Student: It'll be just three of us working on a group project. Librarian: Perfect. We have rooms that can accommodate up to six people. The afternoon slots are 1 PM to 3 PM or 3 PM to 5 PM. Student: The 1 PM slot works better for us. Also, do you have any rooms with computer access? Librarian: Yes, rooms 205, 210, and 215 all have desktop computers and high-speed internet. However, those rooms are an additional $5 per hour. Student: Oh, I see. What about the standard rooms without computers? Librarian: Those are free for all registered students. They have whiteboards and comfortable seating. Student: That sounds good. Let me take the standard room at 1 PM. Librarian: Excellent. I'll need your student ID and email to complete the registration.

questions.q: How many people will be using the study room?
questions.explanation: 학생이 'It'll be just three of us working on a group project'라고 명확히 말했습니다. 따라서 정답은 B입니다.

questions.q: What is the price difference between standard rooms and rooms with computer access?
questions.explanation: 사서가 'Those rooms are an additional $5 per hour'라고 명시했으므로 정답은 B입니다. 표준 방은 무료이고 컴퓨터 접근이 있는 방은 시간당 $5입니다.

questions.q: Which time slot did the student choose for the study room?
questions.explanation: 학생이 'The 1 PM slot works better for us'라고 명시적으로 말했으므로, 정답은 1 PM to 3 PM인 B입니다.
